title: Grenade Venator 4k-6.4k: Cultist Sacrifice (gun 4.8k at 4.8k) or Battle Vest first?
question: The silent edit put Battle Vest before Cultist, moving the gun 4.8k from 4.8k to 6.4k souls. Which order is stronger across 4k-6.4k?
hypothesis: H-VG-1 (calc, council/triage/calc/venator_paths.txt): 4.8k-6.4k: V0 grenade hit 106 vs V1 76 (58 below 65% HP), Gutshot 110 vs 89, gun x1.71 vs x1.51 (x1.23 below 65% HP); V1 has 18% bullet resist (+22% EHP vs bullets) and wins 4.0k-4.8k (grenade 76 vs 58).

arms.name: V0_cultist_first
arms.notes: real tiers at 5.6k (model A): grenade T2, Gutshot U, trap U, ult U; Cultist buff active

controls: Cooldowns and HP reset between trials
Same boons/souls/ability points in both arms except the thing under test
Same bot heroes, HP and resists
procedure: Throw grenade, Gutshot, shoot until magazine empty; record grenade hit number, total damage and own HP lost
Repeat starting at 60% HP (Battle Vest bonus off)

decision.rule: SUPPORTS V0 if damage_mag >=10% higher at full HP and higher at 60% HP; REFUTES (keep V1 with a waiver) if V1 is within 5% damage and loses >=20% less HP; else INCONCLUSIVE (rule default V0).
